newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end firmer, focus on Portucel.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end firmer, focus on Portucel.

text.p: 1707 GMT - Portuguese shares recovered at the close after a volatile session, although the lacklustre opening of Wall Street influenced some stocks such as Portugal Telecom, dealers said. Futures on the PSI-20 .PSI20 index of 20 leading Portuguese stocks ended higher. Turnover in the cash market was just 5.6 billion escudos. Dealers said they did not expect much reaction by Portucel Industrial shares tomorrow to its 1996 loss as the result was in line with expectations. The Lisbon market was expected to focus tomorrow on Banco Portugues de Investimento which will announce its 1996 results, probably after the close. The close of trade on Wall Street today could influence the opening of Lisbon bourse tomorrow amid worries about what U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan will tell Congress this week.
